additional_info.subject: RE: Libra Charging Station: Siemens 150kW Fast Charging Station | Out of Order | Ongoing Failure and Lack of Manufacturer Accountability | Charger MP/NN 170000080 | Charger MP/NN 170000062
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Khan,
Let me be very clear: this situation is
completely unacceptable.
We purchased this EV charger directly from Siemens. Not a reseller. Not a third party. From Siemens—the manufacturer. And yet, after more than four months of ongoing issues, what we’re being told is essentially:
we don’t know how to fix it.
Your latest message suggests we should keep importing parts, at our own cost and risk, with no confirmation that any of them will resolve the problem. That’s simply not acceptable—nor logical. This isn’t some low-cost knockoff. This is supposed to be German engineering. And yet here we are—with a system that doesn’t work and a manufacturer who can’t take clear responsibility for solving the problem.
Let me also remind you how this started. It was your
country MD
and the
German Ambassador
who pushed
me
—multiple times—to adopt this product. I initially had my doubts, but eventually gave in. Why? Because I’m a German national, and of course I believed in the quality and support behind a German brand like Siemens. Naturally, I would place my trust and loyalty in supporting German engineering—not a Chinese alternative.. We didn’t buy one—we bought
two
units. One of them was
never even commissioned
, and yet that unit isn’t working either—and somehow, the blame for that is being placed on us. That’s ridiculous. We were asked to help
launch
Siemens’ EV charging solution in Pakistan. You got your press coverage. Your logo was placed right next to Audi’s. And yet, when the units arrived, your local team had no idea how to operate or configure them. Support had to be escalated abroad because no one on the ground had the required knowledge. That says everything about how unprepared the team was to launch this product. Siemens got the visibility. What we got was a system that’s been broken more often than not.
Meanwhile, our Audi customers—who trusted the premium experience—are constantly asking why the charger is down, why it hasn’t been fixed, and how it’s possible that Siemens can’t resolve it. They’re now going to public chargers at BMW and Mercedes-Benz showrooms—chargers that, by the way, are mostly
Chinese-made and working flawlessly
. This isn’t just hurting the
Audi brand
, it’s eroding trust in the
Siemens brand
. What was meant to be a flagship collaboration has turned into an ongoing embarrassment. And frankly, it feels like Siemens just doesn’t care.
And this isn’t a one-off. In just over two years of operations, this charger has had
more than 9 months of combined downtime
. That’s not just frustrating—that’s outrageous. No critical equipment should be failing this frequently. Certainly not from a company like Siemens.
Your team keeps pointing to warranty limitations. But let’s be honest: if one of our Audi customers came in with a technical issue—regardless of warranty status—and we told them we
might
need to import 3–4 parts, that
maybe
one of them will fix it, but they’ll need to pay for all of them anyway, with no guarantees? That would never fly. We’d lose the client, and we’d deserve to – and lawsuits!.
We expect Siemens to behave like the manufacturer it claims to be. That means:
Taking full ownership of diagnosing and fixing this product.
Providing a clear, conclusive technical explanation of the fault.
Issuing a specific resolution plan—with a guaranteed fix, not vague assumptions.
This charger has been inoperable for far too long. And again—this isn’t a one-off. Over 9 months of downtime in 2 years is indefensible. We need a real solution now—not more guesswork, not more empty responses. I trusted Siemens with this rollout. Now Siemens needs to step up and own the result.
We expect your immediate and serious attention to this matter.
With best regards / Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Ali I. Khan
Member Board of Directors
Premier Motors Limited.
2nd Floor Business Plaza
Mumtaz Hassan Road
74000 Karachi Pakistan
Tel: +92 21 32456 400
Direct: +92 21 32456 444
Fax: +92 21 3242 8777
